about_the_game:
“The skeleton awakens. The soul endures.”

You awaken in a forgotten graveyard, left with nothing but a skeletal body and a hazy sense of self. No one knows why you exist—or even who you are.

In Shell Soul: The Skull, you play as a mysterious being—conscious, yet stripped of all memories. Embark on a journey through an unfamiliar world, recover fragments of your past, and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

A Journey to Find Yourself

Along the way, you'll meet unusual monsters who can speak and share their stories. Help them with their troubles, and in return, they will aid you on your quest.

You’ll gradually discover that you are no ordinary skeleton. A hidden power within you may be the last hope to save this broken world—and it’s leading you to the heart of your fate.

Key Features

  • Versatile Equipment
    Discover 6 main tools scattered across the world. Each grants you unique abilities that help solve puzzles or access new areas.

  • Unlockable Zones
    Certain areas are blocked until you acquire specific items, encouraging exploration and backtracking.

  • Memory Fragments
    Hidden throughout the world, these fragments restore pieces of your lost past and reveal the mystery of your former self.

  • Monster-Based Puzzles
    Use each monster’s traits to solve environmental puzzles and advance through the levels.
